description: Project catalog for this HQ. Add entries under 'projects'; keys starting with '_' (such as '_example') are ignored. Paths can be absolute, home-relative (~/...), or relative to the HQ folder. Fields: path, description, remote, area, tags, status, auto_activate, enabled, worktrees. A project's 'area' selects which Lore overview (lore/<area>/overview.md) loads in repository mode; an optional top-level 'defaultArea' does the same in HQ mode.
